payload.title: Agents continue open PRs and branches before new work
payload.body:
next-task skips red or conflicted PRs, ignores drafts, and never looks at pushed branches or worktrees without a PR, so a new session starts fresh work while parked work (for example a /wrap-up draft PR) waits. Add a step before picking: list your open PRs (drafts too), unmerged branches and worktrees, match them to queued tasks, and continue that work first.
  - **Hypothesis**: Agents resume parked work instead of starting new tasks, so open draft PRs per repo stop growing.
  - **Measurement**: grep -c 'Continue open work' commands/next-task.md commands/claude/skills/next-task/SKILL.md commands/codex/skills/next-task/SKILL.md commands/cursor/next-task.md commands/gemini/next-task.toml
  - **Success**: every generated variant has the step (5 of 5) and commands-drift passes
  - **Pivot**: if agents still start new tasks while a resumable draft PR exists in 2 checkups, move the check into tasks pick
  - **Anchor**: git-town park/continue workflow; owner goal 2026-10-19
